name: Standard-Codec-in-the-Loop (SCL)
definition: A training framework that inserts standard, non-differentiable codecs directly into the neural radiance field training loop using a straight-through estimator (STE) to pass gradients.
summary: Standard-Codec-in-the-Loop (SCL) is a NeRF training framework that inserts standard, non-differentiable codecs directly into the loop using a straight-through estimator to bypass backpropagation, unlike prior methods relying on differentiable proxies.
